take: Asian Paints delivered double-digit revenue expansion in H1 FY27, yet operating margins broke below the guided 18-20% band to 16% in Q2 FY27. Profitability continues to lag topline growth as cost inflation and elevated competitive discounting prevent full margin preservation.

promises.promise: Mid-single-digit value growth for the full year FY26
promises.delivered: FY26 revenue rose 4.95% to ₹35,584 crore from ₹33,906 crore in FY25

promises.promise: Maintain PBDIT margin band of 18 to 20%
promises.delivered: FY26 operating profit margin was 19%, squarely inside the guided range

promises.promise: PBDIT margins to remain within the 18-20% band for FY27
promises.delivered: Q1 FY27 OPM was 21%, but Q2 FY27 dropped to 16%

promises.promise: Stay in the volume region of 8-10% for full FY27
Commission first phase in the first half of the year

narrative.claim: PBDIT margins will hold within the guided 18% to 20% band through FY27
narrative.numbers: Consolidated OPM fell to 16% in Q2 FY27, missing the guided threshold

narrative.claim: Price increases of 6.8% to 11% and premium mix would sustain earnings growth
narrative.numbers: In Q2 FY27, PAT grew only 6.6% YoY despite 16.9% revenue growth

narrative.claim: Full-year FY26 value growth will reach mid-single-digit levels
narrative.numbers: Reported annual revenue rose 4.95% from ₹33,906 crore to ₹35,584 crore

guidance.latest: Commission first phase (VAE) in H1 FY27

bull.point: Topline revenue growth accelerated to 17.9% YoY in Q1 FY27 and 16.9% YoY in Q2 FY27.
Operating cash conversion remains solid, converting 109% of cumulative 5-year net profit into operating cash flow.
Strong working capital control reduced cash conversion cycle from 107 days in FY25 to 84 days in FY26.

bear.point: Operating margins compressed to 16% in Q2 FY27, breaching management's stated floor of 18%.
Debt-to-equity ratio rose steadily from 0.12 in March 2025 to 0.21 by September 2026.
Unabated discounting across retail and contractor channels limits operating leverage despite volume gains.

watch: Recovery of OPM back toward the guided 18-20% band
Net profit growth rate relative to revenue growth in Q3 FY27
Commissioning progress on the backward integration VAM-VAE plant
